children: Applied Industrial Technologies reported revenue of $1.291 billion for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, up 7.6% from a year earlier. Net income increased 9.5% to $110.4 million, while diluted EPS rose 12.9% to $2.97.
Revenue was $1.291B, compared with $1.200B in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 7.6%.
Net income was $110.4M, compared with $100.8M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 9.5%.
Diluted EPS was $2.97, compared with $2.63 in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 12.9%.
Organic sales growth was 7.1%, driven mainly by higher volumes.
Engineered Solutions sales increased 14.1%, with fluid power and automation demand contributing most of the segment’s gains.
Service Center sales rose 4.2%, supported by U.S. demand and internal sales initiatives, partly offset by softer international demand.
U.S. sales increased 8.2%; Canada declined 6.9%, while sales in other countries rose 14.6%.
The company operated 580 facilities and employed approximately 6,800 people at quarter-end.
